cues: Pelayo locks him in the chicken coop with the hens.
That night the rain stops and the baby's fever breaks.
Feeling generous, the couple plan to put the angel on a raft with food and water and leave him to the sea.
But at dawn the whole neighbourhood is at the wire, throwing in food as if he were a circus animal.
